macos.detail: Free Wine + mtld3d runs the original DirectX 9 game through Apple Metal. Requires Apple Silicon, Rosetta 2 and macOS 15+. C&C 3 and RA3 were manually tested on one Mac; Kane’s Wrath remains experimental.
macos.prepare: Pinned, free Wine build + mtld3d Metal renderer in a separate runtime. Existing game profiles and older compatibility engines are retained.
macos.play: Play opens a launch guide and this game’s Windows Steam client. Wait for client updates and sign in there if asked. The launcher requests the game; if the library appears without starting it, use Steam’s Play button for this game once. macOS may ask about microphone access for voice chat. Graphics quality stays in the game. Mods and C&C:Online are not installed yet.

linux.detail: Experimental Steam Proton support. Uses your native Linux Steam client, owned game and Steam-managed Proton. Flatpak Steam is not supported in this first integration.
linux.prepare: Open Steam setup, enable Proton 11 in this game’s Properties → Compatibility, install the English game and start it once. Return here to check readiness.
linux.play: Experimental Steam Proton support. Steam manages runtime updates, saves and its game copy. Launch display options are passed to Steam. Mods and C&C:Online are not installed yet.
